integrity: Proof and numerical diagnostics were checked for the stated theorem; historical priority remains subject to older unindexed rectangular-distance literature. Independent audit was not performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns Euclidean orthotopes in d>=3 and exact small-radius volume-point pair probabilities. The inverse Hölder constant requires compact positive shape bounds; no finite-sample or general convex-body identification is established.
title: Sharp local pair-distance tomography of Euclidean orthotopes
